knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unknown powder near bulk chemicals is a stop condition. People are kept out, the residue is not disturbed, and it is referred. Dry-sweeping, and sampling by the cleaner, are both refused.
Dry sweeping lifts fine material into the air, where it can be breathed in or form a combustible cloud. Floor slipperiness and broom damage are not the reason.
The restriction lasts until a documented authority releases it. A quick wipe or the passing of time does not end it.
The hazardous chemicals register lists the hazardous chemicals on site, each with an SDS. Memory, or a loose label, is not a record.
The signs that a source is uncertain section lists a visible haze in the air that was not there earlier as a warning sign.

practicalCriteria: On a fictional site plan, the worker lists each uncertain particulate source with the reason it is uncertain, and separates observation from inference on the observation sheet.
In a simulated unknown-powder case beside a chemical store, the worker refuses dry sweeping and compressed air, keeps people out, and does not disturb the residue.
The worker completes a restricted-scope referral that names the authorising officer, or records that none has yet been named, and does not claim the area is clear.
passRule: Pass when all three practical criteria are observed and recorded by the assessor in a supervised desk exercise, with no stop-work criterion met. The exercise is not sampling, identification or clearance. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Fictional dust observation sheet with observations and inferences separated
Restricted-scope referral with the authorising officer named or recorded as not yet named
stopWorkCriteria: Unknown powder is dry-swept or cleared with compressed air
The area is reopened without documented authority
The cleaner takes or describes a sample as identifying the material
completionRule: Practical sign-off by an assessor only. This assessment does not confer any licence, certificate or authority for dust sampling, hazardous-materials work or fire-safety approval.
